ncf3e9a0823.headline: Indexation of UZ tariffs for freight transport will sharply slow economic and GDP growth, – expert
ncf3e9a0823.summary: Rising freight tariffs in Uzbekistan are expected to force mining and metallurgical companies to cut wage and modernization plans.
ncf3e9a0823.why: Higher transport costs can reduce industrial competitiveness and slow economic growth in resource-dependent economies.
